messages:
maria: Ran a canary perf sweep just now against the batch-allocator prefetched KV path. p95 for route chat/assistant jumped from ~92ms -> 210ms after the kernel handoff. Not huge on mean but visible spike.

devin: ugh. do you have the flamegraph or top-level metric? which kernel variant rolled in?

maria: flame attached (summary inline). Kernel switched from attn-fast-v2 -> attn-fused-opt at 13:42 UTC on canary. KV hitrate for that route dropped ~8%. p95 timeline: 13:35 88ms, 13:42 210ms, 13:48 95ms.

ash: that kernel swap should be a no-op for this model family. could be interaction with continuous batching heuristics (we changed queue gating last week).

maria: agree. suspect batching forming larger micro-batches due to queue window hysteresis interacting with longer kernel setup on fused-opt -> spikes. Also saw more KV cache misses in the same window (maybe eviction pressure).

perf-bot: perf alert: p95(chat/assistant) exceeded SLO 200ms for 3m at 2026-03-17T13:42:10Z. Trace IDs: trace-78a, trace-78b.

leah: can we reproduce on a minimodel workload? If it's batch formation size + kernel cost, a short seq-length load should show same pattern.

devin: yep I can spin up a focused canary: microrequests with seq=64, rps=60, sticky routing to canary backends. I'll log kernel switch and kv metrics.

maria: posted quick snippet for profiling commands:
```
# run perf sweep
python tools/loadgen.py --route chat/assistant --seq 64 --rps 60 --duration 300 --canary backend-canary-7
# collect kv metrics
kubectl logs -l app=kvcache -c kv -n prod --since=15m | grep hit_rate
```

ash: while you run that, quick thought: the batch allocator uses route-tier token targets that were auto-scaled up for this route. Maybe token target increased microbatch size by ~20% and fused-opt pays a fixed kernel setup cost that dominates short requests. Lowering token budget could help.

maria: tried a manual override to reduce per-route token target from 128 -> 96 and observed immediate p95 drop back under 120ms on the canary instances. Need to validate at scale.

devin: can confirm on my minimodel run: baseline p95=85ms, after kernel swap + default target p95=215ms, after forcing token_target=96 p95=110ms. KV hitrate recovered slightly (~+3%).

leah: interesting that KV improved — lowering batch size reduces competing KV entries? maybe less kv evictions per microbatch. worth instrumenting kv churn metric (evictions/sec).

maria: added evictions/sec to collector. saw 2.3->3.7 evictions/sec during the spike window, dropped to 2.5 after token_target change.

ash: OK actionable plan: 1) roll kernel change back on canary (attn-fused-opt -> attn-fast-v2) and run 1h A/B to isolate kernel impact; 2) add short-term per-route token_target cap for chat/assistant while we test; 3) add a guard in batching heuristic to detect kernel setup latency and prefer smaller microbatches for kernels with expensive setup.

devin: implemented temp cap via rollout flag 'route_cap/chat-assistant=96'. rolling to canary now.

maria: can we also add a heatmap in console (per-route p95 vs microbatch_size) for next-day triage? Would make these regressions faster to debug.

leah: yes, I'll add dashboard tiles: microbatch_size distribution, kv_evictions, kernel_setup_us, p95 per route.

perf-bot: rollout event: feature flag route_cap/chat-assistant=96 deployed to canary at 2026-03-17T14:02:40Z by devops-bot.

maria: after rollout, canary p95 stayed ~108ms for 10m. rolling to 10% prod to confirm.

ash: mid-term: update batch-allocator heuristic to incorporate kernel_profile: {setup_cost_us, per_token_us} during batch formation. Essentially compute expected latency for candidate microbatch sizes and cap by SLO. Might be a simple greedy that avoids combos exceeding p95 budget.

devin: agree. also need to ensure the kernel profiler is light-weight and kept fresh per model+hardware combo.

leah: I'll draft the dashboard and a minimal kernel metadata schema we can add to model manifests.

maria: cool. next steps: devin keep canary A/B running and collect traces for two more hours; leah add dashboard; ash prototype heuristic algorithm; I'll write a short postmortem-ish note if this persists. Thanks all :thumbsup:
